DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A.

The results show a significantly elevated Partial Thromboplastin Time (PTT) of 60 seconds with a normal Prothrombin Time (PT), which is characteristic of an intrinsic pathway defect like Hemophilia A. Given your history of post-extraction bleeding and easy bruising, we must confirm this by checking for Factor VIII activity.
